mapper.sql: create_time, update_time, bool_delete_enum, version, id, project_id, category, inventory_operation_id, area_id, bool_status_enum, bool_abnormal_enum, name, serial_number, plate, width, unfolded_width, thickness, length, quantity, total_length, surface_area, total_area, brand, color, material, weight, total_weight, coating, plating, remark, business_id, attachment_id, bend_times, weight_meter, user_id, produced_quantity, scheduling_quantity
mapper.select:
select cr.id, cr.project_id 'project.id', cp.name 'project.name', cp.short_name 'project.short_name', cp.serial_number 'project.serial_number', cr.monomer_id 'monomer.id', pm.name 'monomer.name', cr.area_id, cr.serial_number, cr.remark, cr.user_id 'user.id', u.name 'user.name', cr.check_status, cr.check_user_id, cr.check_time, cr.create_time, cr.type, check_user.name as check_user_name from tech_enclosure_change_record as cr left join contract_project as cp on cr.project_id = cp.id and cp.bool_delete_enum = 0 left join plan_monomer as pm on cr.monomer_id = pm.id and pm.bool_delete_enum = 0 left join sys_user as u on cr.user_id = u.id left join sys_user as check_user on cr.check_user_id = check_user.id where cr.bool_delete_enum = 0
AND DATE_FORMAT(cr.create_time,'%Y')=DATE_FORMAT(#{year},'%Y')
and (cp.name like concat('%',#{projectName},'%') or cp.short_name like concat('%',#{projectName},'%') or cp.serial_number like concat('%',#{projectName},'%'))
and u.name like concat('%',#{userName},'%')
and check_user.name like concat('%',#{auditName},'%')
and cr.check_status = #{checkStatus}
order by cr.check_status asc, cr.id desc
